evidence: All five dimension prompts in the frozen task open line 1 with 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.' (task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1) and continue 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' Every judge.toml wires exactly one browser MCP server named 'playwright' (command playwright-mcp, --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium, judge.toml lines 8-12 in all five; functional additionally wires the 'verifier' restart_app server, lines 14-18), so 'using Playwright' unambiguously names the Playwright MCP tool; tests/Dockerfile:19 installs @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and links chromium. Each prompt contains {app_context}; tests/test.sh:195-201 (byte-identical to the template test.sh) substitutes tests/app_context.md, which supplies URL http://localhost:3000, the accounts and 'Discover navigation and requests through the visible UI'. Not first-paint: render gate criterion requires a rejected wrong password then a successful sign-in to a usable workspace; constraints gate requires a UI-created job+candidate read back in an independent browser context; functional/polish/visual each restate an in-dimension gate requiring the same UI create + independent-context Observer readback before scoring ('A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check'). Visual (prompt.md:14) requires visiting the Board, an open card, Noor's conversation, Activity and the candidate view as Noor in an independent context, so a single screenshot cannot satisfy it. Polish criteria demand live interactions (focus via document.activeElement, scroll offsets, aborted send, cross-tab sign-out). Functional protocols Z..D are all browser actions/captured-request replays ('Never call a route the UI was not seen to use', 'Never use curl or shell'), with restart_app only in D. Not memory: prompts direct use of 'your own new jobs and cards' with review suffixes and 'never rely on starting counts', so seed-memory answers cannot score; the seeded facts in Z are to be read in the browser. Grep of all criteria for source/sqlite/database/file/shell found only the candidate 'source' field (a product field), no source-reading demand. Deviation from template wording ('using Playwright MCP' -> 'using Playwright') is wording only; the template's browser direction and untrusted-content defense are preserved and strengthened. Counterexample attempts: (a) broken app that could pass - a static/mock shell rendering seed data fails every gate because each requires a server-persisted UI write observed from an independent context; a judge reading source instead of the app is explicitly forbidden in every prompt. (b) conforming alternative that could fail - an app with different routes/labels/no drag-and-drop is covered by 'Discover routes and controls by intent', 'no dragging required', and app_context's 'may use any route layout and labels'. Neither counterexample succeeds against the prompt text. Limits: no configured claude-code judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Not a configured judge run, Oracle grade, model score or judge-duration measurement'), so actual judge adherence and availability of browser_run_code_unsafe in @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 are not measured here; the prompts offer 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative', and tool feasibility/workload belong to other rows. This row's requirement is the prompt content, which is fully verified statically.
